tei:div.tei:p: "!#: sprul sku ratna gling pa'i gter byon mnyam gnyis rtsal 'gran 'ching gsum gnad kyi gdams pa bzhugs so:

bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs dus kyi snyigs ma la: mnyam gnyis rtsal 'gran dar ba'i dus: mthon po gnya' ba bcag pa dang: mnyam pa brang 'og gzhug pa'i phyir: ngan sel gdams pa mang du bsgyur: khyad par 'ching gsum gdams pa la: cog brdung gdams pa dgu dang bcas: bum thang dge gnas de ru sbas: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: mda' rtsed byed dam rta rgyug gam: shwa rgyan rgyal bar byed pa'i tshe: mda' dang rta dang shwa dang ni: pha rol liṅga 'dra 'bag bri: rta la byed na rta gzugs bri: mda' la pha rol mda' dpon bri: rkang lag zhags pas bsdams pa la: dpral bar rus dang snying gar ming: yan lag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbazhis: mtha' skor che ge zhes bya ba'i: stobs dang lus rtsal chings shig dang: bhandha bhandha zhes pa bri: dgug gzhug bya zhing drag tu bstim: de nas drang srong thun sngags gdab: gza' nyi ma yod na: oṃ nyi ma surya a a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: zla ba yod na: oṃ zla ba tsand+ra kṣ+ya kṣ+ya hūm̐: dmag dpon yod na: oṃ dmag dpon pa sha ta pa li breṃ hūm̐: lhag pa yod na: oṃ lhag pa ni sha gha dza dha hūm̐: phur bu yod na: oṃ phur bu shi tri tri hūm̐ hūm̐: pa wa sangs yod na: oṃ pa wā kha sha hūm̐: spen pa yod na: oṃ spen pa tri sha hūm̐: zhes pa'i sngags rnams kyi sham bur: che ge mo'i mda' dang rtsal chings shig: che ge mo'i shwa grangs chings shig: rta'i bang chings shig: ces pa gang 'dod bgrang: de'i nyin gyi gza' gang yod kyi sngags kyi sham bur btags la bzlas la: thun la bsngags te liṅga la brab: sngags brgya stong grangs thems pa dang: liṅga yugs sa'i phang lo'i mig tu brdzang: de pho rog dang 'ug pa'i sder mo'i bar du bcug la tshon skud phyir log dkris: rta 'ching dgra'i 'og tu sba: mda' 'ching 'ben gyi 'og tu sba: shwa 'ching shwa'i 'og tu sba: g.yam sa'i 'og tu mnan nas kyang: drang srong gza' la gtor ma phul: gza' dar rang gi mgo la bcing:

yugs sa nag mo'i rkang rjes sa: lhang ma lhang tsher phye ma rnams: tshom bu kho yis ma tshor bar: spyi bo'i gtsug tu gdab par bya: des ni kho yi pho lha 'drogs: gang zhig de yi rtsal dang ni: nyin re'i bsod nams nges par 'ching: bya ba zin nas mnan pa 'don: liṅga me 'am chu la gshegs: rdzas rnams dben par sba bar bya: 'ching gsum gnad kyi gdams pa 'di: shin tu zab kyang sdig che 'o: re re tsam las ma spel cig: rang gi snying gi dkyil du chongs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa 'di ni sprul sku ratna gling pas bum thang dge gnas nas gter nas gdan drangs pa'o// bya'i sngags 'chang bkra shis rnam rgyal la zhus shing phyag len ma zab nges yin gsungs pa 'dug go /maṅga laṃ/// /
